finsights.brief: Has raised its dividend for 5 consecutive years

summary: Riyad Bank H1 2026 net income rose 4% YoY to SAR 5.3B; EPS of $0.6225 missed forecast by 0.48%, revenue $4.74B missed by 2.67%
Cost-to-income ratio hit record low of 29.2%; NPL ratio improved to 0.88% from 1.13% YoY; Tier 1 capital ratio reached 16.7%
Management raised FY2026 guidance: loan growth mid-high single digit, cost-to-income below 30%, Tier 1 capital above 17.5%
Completed SAR 10B AT1 Sukuk (3x oversubscribed) to support Vision 2030 lending; capital deployment planned over five years
Strategy focuses on selective growth over volume, scaling retail, AI integration; expects stronger H2 as regional conditions stabilize
